text:
Nina P: Quick pre-event standup for tomorrow's meetup pop-up. Final checks: swag, speaking slot (10 min), lead capture, and onsite post.
Rob: Swag counts? I have 150 shirts, 400 stickers, 250 postcards. Can we re-route 50 postcards to be A/B QR versions (webinar vs benchmark PDF)?
swag-bot: Swag manifest updated: Shirts:150 Stickers:400 Postcards:250 -> 50 cards marked QR-B (A/B).
Clara: A/B QR sounds good. Make sure the webinar form tags source=meetup23 and variant=A/B recorded. Jess, can AV handle HDMI + lapel mic?
Jesse (events): Yes. I'll bring lapel mic, spare batteries, HDMI, and a small projector. Load-in 08:30.
Nina P: Lead flow: QR should create contact in HubSpot, tag meetup23, immediately send webinar invite, and flag AE if company_size>50. Rob, any changes?
Rob: HubSpot workflow present. Tested webhook to AE queue. Also added utm_campaign=meetup23 to both QR versions.
ops-bot: Parking permit and insurance uploaded. Reminder: bring clipboard as fallback for non-scanners.
Clara: Social copy short X: "At Meetup tonight? Swing by our table for LLM demos, benchmarks & swag. Scan to join our webinar waitlist." Keep claims generic.
Nina P: Great. Final: meet at 08:15 at West loading dock. I'll post live QR image when we set up. :rocket:
